metadata.name: Romanization of Greek -- UNGEGN 4.0 (transcription)
notes:
Diffed against the UN Romanization of Greek for Geographical Names (1987)
 table, transcription version, as published in the WGRS Report on the Current
 Status of UN Romanization Systems for Geographical Names, version 4.0 (March
 2016) (eki.ee/wgrs/rom1_el.htm; also unstats wgrr4greek): all 24 rows, the
 eight context combinations (αυ av/af, ευ ev/ef, ηυ iv/if, γγ ng, γξ nx, γχ nch,
 μπ b/mp) with footnotes A-D, and notes 1-4 verified. The context-dependent
 variants are encoded by the dependency elot-ell-Grek-Latn-743-1982-ts, whose
 table implements the ELOT 743 rules the UN system is based on (res. V/19).
